subject: ela
intro: Pick the relationship between people, events, or ideas.

items.prompt:
Read.

Heavy rain caused the river to flood.

The relationship is:
A) cause and effect
B) a comparison
C) a list

steps: Rain causes flood. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A person whose discovery stops a disease has ____ the event.
A) ignored
B) influenced
C) ended without reason

steps: Person affected the outcome. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Steps that must happen in order (seed, roots, stem) form a:
A) comparison
B) sequence
C) contrast

Read.

When the factory closed, workers lost jobs, and nearby shops soon closed too.

The factory closing and the shops closing are connected by:
A) cause and effect
B) rhyme
C) nothing

steps: One led to the other. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Edison's light bulb changed how people lived at night.

How did Edison influence daily life?
A) He had no effect
B) His invention gave people light at night
C) He stopped people from working
items.answer: B) His invention gave people light at night

steps: Person caused change. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) His invention gave people light at night

items.prompt:
Read.

Better farming tools led to bigger harvests, which fed more people.

This text mainly shows a chain of:
A) causes and effects
B) rhymes
C) opinions

steps: Each step causes the next. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The new dam provided electricity to the town, which drew new factories, which created many jobs.

The BEST description of these connections is:
A) a chain of cause and effect (each step leads to the next)
B) a simple comparison
C) an unrelated list
items.answer: A) a chain of cause and effect (each step leads to the next)

solution.answer: A) a chain of cause and effect (each step leads to the next)

items.prompt:
To EXPLAIN how two events are related, a good reader should:
A) use specific details from the text as evidence
B) guess without reading
C) count the paragraphs
items.answer: A) use specific details from the text as evidence

steps: Cite the text. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) use specific details from the text as evidence
